Author: Lucas
Name: DLSS Fix
Punchline: DLSS at a fixed internal resolution, no dynamic resolution.
Description: Locks FFXIV's DLSS to a fixed internal resolution (DLAA / Quality / Balanced / Performance / Ultra Performance / Custom) instead of the game's dynamic resolution. Also picks the DLSS model preset, adds CAS sharpening, and checks that the game's graphics options are set right.
